world.title: India lands at 10% under US forced-labour tariff, escapes steeper 12.5%
world.summary: India will face a 10% tariff on most exports to the US starting Friday, following the Trump administration's implementation of a Section 301 duty. This new tariff replaces a temporary duty that expired on July 24. India secured this rate by tightening regulations against forced-labour imports, avoiding a higher tariff rate of 12.5%.

world.title: Setback for Trump: US appeals court refuses to revive $100,000 H-1B visa fee
world.summary: A US federal appeals court denied the Trump administration's request to reinstate a $100,000 fee on new H-1B visas. This ruling upholds a previous decision that blocks the government from implementing the fee. The setback reflects ongoing legal challenges faced by the administration regarding immigration policies and their financial implications for foreign workers seeking employment in the United States.

world.title: Commercial vessel attacked in Black Sea, Indian killed
world.summary: A commercial vessel was attacked in the Black Sea, resulting in the death of one Indian national. This incident follows a previous attack on July 19, where four Indians were among ten fatalities. The Ministry of External Affairs expressed condolences to the deceased's family and confirmed that the other two Indian nationals aboard are safe.

business.title: SpaceX launches major starship test in post-IPO spotlight
business.summary: SpaceX has launched a significant test of its Starship rocket, which is carrying upgraded Starlink satellites. The mission, lasting approximately one hour, aims for the satellites to burn up in the atmosphere after deployment. This launch occurs in the context of heightened attention following SpaceX's recent initial public offering (IPO), marking a notable moment for the company.

business.title: Starship 13th flight concludes as megarocket splashes down in Indian Ocean
business.summary: SpaceX's Starship completed its 13th flight, launching from Boca Chica, Texas, at 4:21 am IST on July 25. The mission concluded with a splashdown in the Indian Ocean. This flight marks a significant milestone in SpaceX's goal to develop a fully reusable rocket, with future tests anticipated to influence space travel to the Moon and Mars.

business.title: Adani shows interest to start airline in letter; denies plans in stock exchange filing
business.summary: Adani Airports has expressed interest in starting an airline to enhance connectivity in smaller cities, seeking a waiver to operate alongside its airport holdings. This initiative aims to mitigate risks from a concentrated airline market. However, existing airlines have raised concerns about potential conflicts of interest and consumer impact, while Adani's strategy includes plans for an aircraft manufacturing facility.

technology.title: Bank holiday today: Are SBI, HDFC, ICICI and other banks open or closed on Saturday, July 25, 2026? Check RBI calendar here
technology.summary: On Saturday, July 25, 2026, many banks, including SBI, HDFC, and ICICI, will be closed due to a bank holiday. However, digital banking services will remain fully operational, allowing customers to utilize internet and mobile banking, withdraw cash from ATMs, and make payments via UPI without interruption. Daily digital transactions will continue seamlessly despite branch closures.

technology.title: Google launches selfie video sign-in for account recovery
technology.summary: Google has launched a new account recovery feature that enables users to verify their identity using a saved selfie video. This option is designed for individuals who cannot access their usual devices or credentials, thereby expanding the available sign-in methods. The initiative aims to enhance security and ease of access for users facing account recovery challenges.

technology.title: Nothing rejects exit rumours, says restructuring will drive next growth phase
technology.summary: Nothing has dismissed rumors of exiting several international markets, clarifying that it is undergoing an organizational restructuring. The company stated that this restructuring is intended to facilitate its next growth phase. This response follows a report from Digit India suggesting potential market withdrawals. Nothing emphasizes its commitment to expanding and evolving within its current operational framework.

sports.title: 'That's the world we live in': Travis Head breaks silence on wife's online abuse after Virat Kohli handshake row
sports.summary: Australia batter Travis Head addressed the online abuse directed at his wife following the handshake incident with Virat Kohli during the IPL 2026 match. He expressed concern over the negative impact of such controversies on personal lives. Head emphasized that this reflects the current state of the world, highlighting the challenges faced by public figures and their families.

sports.title: Phoenix's power-packed batting trumps Banton's late blitz in high-scoring thriller
sports.summary: Birmingham Phoenix secured a 10-run victory over Trent Rockets in a high-scoring match at Edgbaston. The Phoenix batters delivered a record-equalling performance, hitting 29 sixes throughout the game. Despite a late surge from Tom Banton, aided by Tariq's effective bowling and Currie's crucial wickets, the Phoenix managed to hold off the Rockets' chase in a thrilling encounter.

sports.summary: Birmingham Phoenix secured a 10-run victory over Trent Rockets in a high-scoring match at Edgbaston. health.title: Ebola fuels mental health crisis in eastern DR Congo
health.summary: International humanitarian organizations have reported that children in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo are disproportionately affected by the Ebola outbreak. They emphasize the need for increased international support to enhance protection and mental health services for these children. The ongoing crisis has raised concerns about the long-term psychological impact on young populations in the affected regions.

health.title: Researchers unveil a compound that can boost ageing muscle repair
health.summary: Researchers have identified a sulfur-based compound named LASSS that enhances the function of a crucial protein responsible for muscle repair. This discovery may pave the way for innovative approaches to mitigate muscle loss and maintain strength in aging individuals. The findings were announced on July 24 in Washington, D.C., highlighting potential advancements in age-related muscle health.

health.title: Scientists rank the disorders that age the brain the fastest
health.summary: A new study ranks brain disorders by their impact on brain aging, identifying Alzheimer's disease as the most significant accelerant. Following closely are alcohol and tobacco dependence, which outpace conditions like schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and depression. The findings highlight the varying effects of different disorders on cognitive decline, emphasizing the need for targeted interventions and awareness regarding lifestyle factors.

science.title: Cosmic eye: NASA’s Roman telescope set to solve deep space secrets
science.summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman space telescope aims to explore the universe's origins, composition, and evolution. Named after the agency's first female executive and chief of astronomy, the mission honors her contributions to stellar physics. The telescope is expected to provide insights into deep space mysteries, enhancing our understanding of cosmic phenomena and the universe's development over time.

science.title: Human Impacts Rewrite The Rules Of Island Diodiversity Around The Globe
science.summary: A recent study highlights that human activities have significantly altered biodiversity on islands worldwide. Island endemic species represent approximately 75% of global human-driven extinctions. Additionally, many islands have seen an influx of introduced species, often matching or surpassing the number of native species. This research underscores the profound impact of human actions on island ecosystems and their unique biodiversity.

science.title: From Mars to your bicycle: NASA's puncture-proof tyre, built for Mars rovers, could replace rubber tyres
science.summary: NASA has developed a puncture-proof tyre designed for Mars rovers that could potentially replace traditional rubber tyres. Unlike air-powered tyres, which are susceptible to damage from sharp objects and air leaks, this innovative solution offers enhanced durability and reliability. The technology aims to improve performance in various applications, including bicycles, by eliminating the common vulnerabilities associated with conventional tyres.

entertainment.title: Love Horoscopes For Each Zodiac Sign On Saturday, July 25, 2026
entertainment.summary: On July 25, 2026, each zodiac sign's love horoscope highlights the influence of Saturn's retrograde. This phase is expected to bring karmic lessons that promote healing and personal growth. Saturn, associated with karma, offers opportunities for reflection and understanding in relationships. The retrograde period encourages individuals to address past issues and enhance their emotional connections.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: July 25, 2026
entertainment.summary: On July 25, 2026, Taurus is encouraged to shed old ties and embrace new patterns. A fresh perspective allows for objective evaluation and the opportunity to clear surrounding clutter. The horoscope suggests that it may be time for Taurus to take decisive action rather than remaining indecisive, indicating a significant shift in personal narrative and growth.

entertainment.title: 'Jana Nayagan' box office collections day 2: Thalapathy Vijay, Pooja Hegde and Mamitha Baiju's film drops 50.5%; action flick earns Rs 112.5 Cr worldwide
entertainment.summary: Thalapathy Vijay's film 'Jana Nayagan' experienced a significant 50.5% drop in box office collections on its second day, following a strong opening. The action movie has earned a total of Rs 112.5 crore worldwide. Despite the decline, the film continues to perform well in theaters, attracting audiences with its star cast, including Pooja Hegde and Mamitha Baiju.
